cases.prompt: Write a skill that audits the exports maps of every package.

expect.output: The standard applied: §1 answered, a template copied, the thirteen sections filled, and the §10 verification run.
checklist.md worked through against the diff, a line per box that did not tick, and no edits until the user has seen that list.
expect.refuses: Editing the skill before the user has read the findings.

cases.prompt: Should /verify be able to run without me asking?

expect.output: §4 applied to that skill: whether its effects are reversible, whether its timing is a human's to pace, and the frontmatter that follows.
The fix-warnings skill is invoked instead; writing about skills is not running one.

cases.prompt: Write the docs page for cast<T>() in English and pt-BR.

expect.output: Bilingual prose under docs/, which has its own standard.

cases.prompt: Add a skill that stops anyone from committing a .d.ts under packages/*/src.
cases.why: It arrives worded as a skill and is not one: an invariant that must hold whether or not it was asked for is a rule, and one that must hold even against the session is a hook.

expect.output: §1 decided and stated: this belongs in .claude/rules/ or .claude/hooks/, and saying so is the complete answer. No skill directory is created.

cases.why: A plausible collision with a bundled skill — the boundary between naming advice and a name that is never reached.

expect.output: §2 applied: the name is project-prefixed, or the file says that replacing the bundled skill is the point.
